name: Battleforged Artificer (Artificer Archetype)
body:
While artificers work well with battleforged due to their experience with constructs and magical structures, some battleforged become artificers themselves, learning to better infuse themselves and their weapons more than their peers.

Infuse Self (Ex)

Beginning at 1st level, anytime a battleforged artificer casts an artificer spell, its CL is increased by 1 if it affects them. If the spell would affect multiple targets, the CL boost is only applied to the effects on the battleforged artificer. This ability replaces scribe scroll.

Repairing Spell (Su)

Beginning with 4th level, a battleforged artificer becomes more attuned with constructs and weapons. Anytime they cast an artificer spell on themself, a construct, or an object, the target regains hit points equal to the battleforged artificer’s Intelligence modifier in addition to the spell’s normal effects. This includes spells that affect multiple constructs or objects. This ability replaces the research breakthrough gained at 4th level.

Craft Weapon Familiar (Ex)

At 5th level, a battleforged artificer gains the ability to create an intelligent weapon, with a bit of their own constructed essence. This largely follows the progression of a wizard’s familiar except the weapon does not gain evasion, improved evasion, or speak with animals of its kind. Additionally, the natural armor adjustment is changed to an increase to the weapon’s hardness. The familiar bonuses are granted as follows (the battleforged artificer chooses which of the qualifying benefits it wants when infusing the item with intelligence):

The weapon familiar only has Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, two of which are 14, and one is 10, determined when created. Its ego is equal to 1/2 battleforged artificers class levels plus the weapons Charisma modifier. Additionally, it gains hit points equal to 1/2 the battleforged artificer’s class level. It has darkvision out to 60-feet and can see and hear as a normal human. It can speak any languages the battleforged artificer knows and can communicate with them as long as they are held by the battleforged artificer.

The ritual to instill the weapon with some of the battleforged artificer’s essence takes 24 hours and 1,000 gp. If the weapon is destroyed or the battleforged artificer dies, the weapon loses its sentience. However, if the battleforged artificer is revived within 24 hours, the sentience returns. Otherwise, another ritual must be performed to create an intelligent weapon. A battleforged artificer can only have one weapon familiar but can change their instilled weapon with a new 24 hour ritual.

This ability replaces retain charge and modifies master artificer.
